integrity: The universal formula is proved from the published Type-A characterization and an injective-surjective canonical count; finite exhaustive computation is corroborative rather than a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem enumerates reconstruction-graph edges and average degree, not the full degree distribution or optimal code size. Literature searches cannot exclude a differently indexed prior enumeration.
title: Exact edge count of the finite-alphabet two-read single-deletion reconstruction graph
